text: His discoveries acquired him great reputation during his ten years offence at Paris, and he did not forget to affect, that Picard and Caffini took the merit of ma-ny things which belonged exclusively to himself. Roe- men was the first period who discovered the velocity with which light moves, by norms of the eclipse of Jupiter’s fatalities, determining it to be about 7 or 8 minutes in coming from the foot to the earth. This opinion was opposed by many, but it was afterwards demonstrated a mod ingeous manner by Dr Bradley.
